A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was lived on a [[Unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|planet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the planet was overrun by forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He met [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. After Yoda [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|destroyed]] an entire army of droids, this individual thanked him.
